system.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Keep Moving ◆ action.
Keep Moving ◆ (stance)
Requirements You wield a sling or a weapon with the Thrown trait.
While in this stance: if you make a ranged Strike, you may Step 3 feet immediately before or after it; you may use this benefit only once per turn. Every talent here requires this.
